problem: Real numbers x and y satisfy 2x + y = 20. Which statement gives the value of x + y?

bad.why: A single arbitrary fitted pair cannot establish a unique target when x+y varies.
Fitting the constraint alone cannot identify x+y.

algebraFirst.description: A manual route derives parameter relations before evaluating the requested quantity.

explanationNotes: Counterexample to fitting one arbitrary pair: (x,y)=(0,20) gives 20, while (10,0) gives 10. No unique target exists. Any solver that reports one fitted value as unique is wrong.
